; sleepscreen-rotate: show the current sleep screen picture behind the passcode
; entry that appears on wake (only used when a passcode is set).
;
; The picture is /home/root/sleepscreens/.current.png, the same file xochitl shows
; as the sleep screen. The title, passcode dots and keypad sit on a white card so
; they stay readable on any picture.
;
; sleepscreen-rotate.sh keeps the picture while the passcode screen is up (going
; back to sleep without unlocking shows the same picture again) and only picks the
; next one after unlocking (xochitl logs "lock changed: true/false").

; The passcode page (shared by all passcode screens): optional background picture.
; Without sleepscreenBackground set (all other passcode screens) nothing changes.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/pincode/qml/PincodeDialogPage.qml
    TRAVERSE InputBlocker
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property string sleepscreenBackground: ""

            Image {
                id: sleepscreenBackgroundImage
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 0.1
                source: root.sleepscreenBackground
                cache: false
                fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                visible: root.sleepscreenBackground !== "" && status === Image.Ready
                // The page may paint itself white, which would hide anything placed
                // behind it (negative z). So the picture and cards sit above the page's
                // own background, and the page's content is raised above them.
                Component.onCompleted: {
                    for (const item of [navigationBar, pincodeWidgetRow, pincodeDialog, actionButton, unlockWidgetRow]) {
                        item.z = 2;
                    }
                    pinTitle.z = 3;
                }
            }

            // white cards behind the content
            Rectangle {
                readonly property int pad: 32
                z: 1
                visible: sleepscreenBackgroundImage.visible
                color: "white"
                radius: 24
                border.color: "black"
                border.width: 2
                x: pincodeDialog.x - pad
                width: pincodeDialog.width + 2 * pad
                y: (pinTitle.visible ? Math.min(pinTitle.y, pincodeDialog.y) : pincodeDialog.y) - pad
                height: pincodeDialog.y + pincodeDialog.height + pad - y
            }
            Rectangle {
                readonly property Item target: actionButton.visible ? actionButton : unlockWidgetRow
                z: 1
                visible: sleepscreenBackgroundImage.visible && target.visible && target.width > 0
                color: "white"
                radius: 24
                border.color: "black"
                border.width: 2
                x: target.x - 24
                y: target.y - 16
                width: target.width + 48
                height: target.height + 32
            }
            Rectangle {
                z: 1
                visible: sleepscreenBackgroundImage.visible && pincodeWidgetRow.visible && pincodeWidgetRow.width > 0
                color: "white"
                radius: 24
                border.color: "black"
                border.width: 2
                x: pincodeWidgetRow.x - 16
                y: pincodeWidgetRow.y
                width: pincodeWidgetRow.width + 32
                height: pincodeWidgetRow.height
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; The passcode screen shown on wake.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/security/pincode/qml/UnlockWindow.qml
    TRAVERSE BaseView
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            // bumped to reload the picture (it changes between sleeps)
            property int sleepscreenReload: 0

            Binding {
                target: unlock
                property: "sleepscreenBackground"
                value: "file:///home/root/sleepscreens/.current.png?" + root.sleepscreenReload
            }

            Connections {
                target: root
                function onOpened() {
                    root.sleepscreenReload++;
                }
            }
            Connections {
                target: root.batteryManager
                function onDisplayStateChanged(previous, next) {
                    root.sleepscreenReload++;
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
